metadata.question: Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Palm Springs, California reach 115 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need temperature data for Palm Springs, California - Date range: June 15-21, 2017 - Should use MODIS Land Surface Temperature or similar - MODIS LST products: MOD11A1 (Terra) or MYD11A1 (Aqua) - daily 1km resolution - Or use ERA5 reanalysis data for air temperature 2. Masking strategy: - For MODIS LST, need to apply QA band masking to filter bad quality pixels - No cloud masking needed for temperature question - Need to check if data exists and if valid pixels remain after QA filtering 3. Logic: - Valid result: Temperature values in reasonable range (Kelvin or Celsius) - Convert to Fahrenheit: (K - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32 - 115°F = 46.1°C = 319.26K - Check if max temperature >= 115°F during the period - Null/Error (C3): If temperature is None, NaN, or unreasonable (e.g., <-100°F or >150°F) - Empty (C1): If no images in collection - No valid pixels (C2): If all pixels masked out by QA ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const palmSprings = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.5453, 33.8303]); const startDate = '2017-06-15'; const endDate = '2017-06-22'; // exclusive end date // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Using MODIS Terra Daily LST (1km resolution) let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(palmSprings); const colSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No data available for the specified period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Extract day and night LST, apply QA mask function maskLST(image) { const qa = image.select('QC_Day'); // QA bits 0-1: LST quality (00 = good) const goodQuality = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); return image.updateMask(goodQuality); } collection = collection.map(maskLST); // 4. Calculation - Get maximum temperature across all days const lstDay = collection.select('LST_Day_1km'); const maxLST = lstDay.max(); // Check valid pixel count const pixelCount = maxLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: palmSprings, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels after QA masking: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after quality masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Get max temperature value const maxTempK = maxLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: palmSprings, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (maxTempK === null || maxTempK === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed - no valid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert from Kelvin to Fahrenheit // MODIS LST is in Kelvin * 0.02 const maxTempKelvin = maxTempK * 0.02; const maxTempF = (maxTempKelvin - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32; console.log(`Max temperature: ${maxTempKelvin.toFixed(2)}K = ${maxTempF.toFixed(2)}°F`); // Sanity check if (maxTempF < -50 || maxTempF > 160) { console.log("Temperature outside reasonable range."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if reached 115°F if (maxTempF >= 115.0) { console.log(`Temperature reached/exceeded 115°F (${maxTempF.toFixed(1)}°F)`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Temperature did not reach 115°F (max: ${maxTempF.toFixed(1)}°F)`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
